newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank calls news conference on unit.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank calls news conference on unit.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank AG said on Tuesday it has called a news conference at short notice for Wednesday at 1000 GMT regarding the management board's decision regarding a subsidiary.
A bank spokesman said the news conference had nothing to do with recurring market speculation that Vereinsbank may be taken over by Deutsche Bank AG.
"It concerns the management board's decision on a subsidiary, not the big issue of concentration in the banking sector," a Vereinsbank spokesman said.
He declined to reveal further details.

Noris Verbraucherbank GmbH, a banking subsidiary of the Schickedanz group, last week had announced it was seeking a partner for cooperation and there has been speculation that Vereinsbank may be a possible candidate.

Also, Vereinsbank on Monday said it and fellow German bank Commerzbank AG would meet to discuss the future of theri joint investment fund unit ADIG. Commerzbank and Vereinsbank each own just under 43 percent of ADIG.

Platow Brief newsletter reported on Monday that ADIG's owners were unhappy with the present ownership structure and said the unit might either be split or taken over fully by Commerzbank or Vereinsbank.
